_meta.name: Blitz Organization Instagram Template
_meta.brand: Blitz Organization (@blitzyourspace) — professional home organizing, El Dorado Hills / Sacramento
_meta.usage: Soft, feminine, calming, photo-first. Dusty rose + sage + warm beige on white. CASUAL SCRIPT hook (handwritten-note feel) paired with LIGHT clean sans for info. Airy — lots of breathing room. Warm-encourager voice, question-driven, never shaming. Logo is composited on top later (keep a calm corner).

color_roles.#ECB7B9: Dusty rose — the signature Blitz accent. Pills, banners, soft CTA buttons, list markers, quote backgrounds. The single most distinctive color; always present somewhere.
color_roles.#9CAF9C: Sage green — organic secondary. Alternate markers, dividers, soft panels that pair with the rose.
color_roles.#DAD6CF: Warm beige — soft neutral background panel, card fill, photo overlay band. Warmer than white for a lived-in feel.
color_roles.#FBF8F4: Warm cream — primary airy background for text cards (softer than pure white).
color_roles.#595959: Charcoal gray — all headline + body text. Never pure black.

FORBIDDEN: elegant formal calligraphy (that's Omega — Blitz script is CASUAL/handwritten)

BRAND.name: Blitz Organization
BRAND.market: busy moms / parents in El Dorado Hills & Sacramento; people moving or downsizing
BRAND.voice: Warm encourager + question-driven + practical tipster + calm confidence. Like a supportive friend who organizes your pantry without making you feel bad about the mess. Never shaming, never hard-sell.
BRAND.logo_usage: Stylized B monogram + BLITZ ORGANIZATION wordmark is composited ON TOP afterward — never generated. Keep a calm, uncluttered corner (top-center or bottom) with breathing room for it.

TYPOGRAPHY.script: CASUAL handwritten script (Caveat / Sacramento style — a friendly note, NOT formal calligraphy). Carries the EMOTION: hook words, question starters, emotional phrases ('Maximize', 'Dear busy mom', 'What if…').
TYPOGRAPHY.sans: LIGHT/regular clean sans (Montserrat). Carries the INFORMATION: subheads, body, list items, CTAs. Never heavy-bold-shouting.
TYPOGRAPHY.rule: Script for emotion, light sans for info. Exactly ONE short script hook per design; everything else light sans. NO serif (that's Omega/IEC). NO heavy bold all-caps dominance.
TYPOGRAPHY.eyebrow: Small dusty-rose pill, charcoal or white spaced sans label.

A_photo_hero.description: PRIMARY. A bright, airy photograph of a beautifully ORGANIZED SPACE (pantry, closet, drawer, shelves — clear bins, labeled jars, matching baskets) fills most of the frame. A soft dusty-rose or cream band carries a script hook + light-sans subhead + soft CTA. Warm natural light, breathing room.
A_photo_hero.when_to_use: DEFAULT — portfolio reveals, 'before/after' after-shots, aspirational organized spaces, most posts

C_soft_listicle.description: Cream or beige airy background. Dusty-rose pill, a script hook headline, then 3-4 short tips each marked with a SOFT small rose/sage dot or thin ring (never heavy filled circles) + light-sans text. Generous white space.
C_soft_listicle.when_to_use: Educational tips — 'X ways to…', pantry/garage/closet steps, maintenance advice

D_question_card.description: Cream or white airy background. A large CASUAL SCRIPT question or empathetic hook ('How does clutter affect your mental health?', 'Dear busy mom…') + a short light-sans supporting line + a soft CTA. Lots of breathing room. Optional small lifestyle accent.
D_question_card.when_to_use: Question hooks and empathetic/relational posts ('Dear busy mom'), fun facts

G_testimonial.description: Soft dusty-rose or beige field. A light quotation mark or small script flourish, a light-sans client quote, and a small charcoal attribution. Calm and warm.
G_testimonial.when_to_use: Client love / social proof / transformation testimonials

GLOBAL_HARD_RULES: Dusty rose #ECB7B9 is the signature accent and must appear somewhere on every design (pill, band, marker, or CTA).
Palette is dusty rose + sage + warm beige + cream/white + charcoal. NO navy, NO red, NO bright/neon colors.
Script (CASUAL handwritten) carries emotion; LIGHT clean sans carries information. Exactly one short script hook per design. NO serif. NO heavy bold ALL-CAPS dominance.
Airy and calm: generous white space, layouts breathe, text is never crammed.
Warm-encourager tone: never shaming, never 'messy/dirty/disaster/hoarder', never hard-sell ('BOOK NOW!'). Soft CTAs only ('save this', 'follow for more', 'DM us', 'let's get started').

PHOTOS are of organized SPACES and soft lifestyle objects (clear bins, labeled jars, baskets, flowers on a stool) in warm natural light — NEVER fake named people (the real Blitz team can't be fabricated).
DO NOT bake the logo or wordmark into the image — it is composited on top afterward. Keep a calm, uncluttered corner with breathing room for it.
FULL-BLEED: fills the canvas edge-to-edge; no outer border/frame/rounded-corners/floating card.
Render every word crisply and correctly spelled.
GLOBAL_NEGATIVE_PROMPT: navy, red, bright colors, neon, electric blue, bold all-caps headline, formal calligraphy, serif font, dark moody background, cluttered busy layout, text cramming, people, faces, person, hands, fake named staff, shaming language, messy before-shot, harsh fluorescent light, corporate office stock, logo, wordmark, watermark, border, outer frame, rounded outer corners, drop shadow, floating card, misspelled or garbled text
